parsed.rationale: Both participating records in this cluster have `is_test: true` and reside in the same test file `Shared/Playback/Tests/MP3StreamerTests/AudioEnginePlayerTests.swift`. The high Jaccard similarity (0.909) between `AudioEnginePlayerTests.testPlay` (line 115) and `AudioEnginePlayerTests.testPlayIdempotent` (line 134) is expected: the idempotency test deliberately repeats the play setup to assert that calling play twice produces the same outcome, making the structural near-duplication intentional by design. Collapsing these two test methods would destroy the semantic distinction between a basic play assertion and an idempotency assertion.
